propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep builds one git log history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, stalling every writer for minutes; the real deployed cost is worse due to per-ticket map misses falling through to per-event wildcard walks.

The sweep must hoist the read-only git log walk out of the critical section by building one position-keyed commit map before acquiring any lock, then execute only the SNAPSHOT write, renames and commit inside the lock window.

The sweep's git add -A staging and lack of mid-run lock re-probe allow concurrent writers' uncommitted events to be swept into the compaction commit and leave the sweep holding the lock across an entire ticket sequence.

The fix must preserve backward compatibility: the optional prebuilt map parameter to _build_authorship_ledger must default to None so the fsck rebuild path and existing test call sites remain unchanged and perform per-ticket walks as appropriate.
